parameters.help_en: This parameter is used to ensure that the modified resource is consistent with the resource to be modified. You can obtain the parameter value from the responses of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190054.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190056.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190055.html operations

parameters.name: if_match

parameters.help_en: The role that is used by the event source such as Object Storage Service (OSS) to invoke the function. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53102.html
parameters.help_zh: 事件源（如OSS）调用函数所需的角色。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53102.html
parameters.name: invocation_role

parameters.help_en: The version or alias of the service
parameters.name: qualifier

parameters.help_en:
The configurations of the trigger. The configurations vary based on the trigger type. For more information about the format, see the following topics:

Object Storage Service (OSS) trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html.
Simple Log Service trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html.
Time trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html.
HTTP trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html.
Tablestore trigger: Specify the SourceArn parameter and leave this parameter empty.
Alibaba Cloud CDN event trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415674.html.
MNS topic trigger: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html.
EventBridge triggers: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2508622.html
parameters.help_zh:
触发器配置，针对不同类型的触发器，配置有所不同。具体格式请参考如下对应的数据结构：

OSS触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html。
日志服务触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html。
定时触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html。
HTTP触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html。
Tablestore触发器：只需要填写完整的SourceArn参数便可，这里无需额外配置，取值为空{}。
CDN事件触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415674.html。
MNS主题触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html。
EventBridge触发器：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2508622.html
parameters.name: trigger_config
